constraints.description: Threads, direct and ACP sessions/runs, conversation policy/configuration, memories, knowledge bases, documents, and chunks use only the verified JWT subject as their authorization owner.

validation.validation_method: Focused live direct-API and ACP test with unauthenticated rejection plus two independently encoded and server-verified JWT subjects

constraints.description: Every persistence provider scopes knowledge and session operations by owner; durable providers permit equal logical IDs without collision or cross-owner parent links.

validation.validation_method: All-provider compile, real SurrealKV equal-ID tests, and PostgreSQL 17 migration plus equal-ID/foreign-key test

constraints.description: A configured knowledge-base selection that resolves to no accessible owner rows returns no chunks and never becomes an all-KB search.

validation.validation_method: Owner-scoped search denial plus runtime branch inspection

constraints.description: Evidence records the observed PostgreSQL migration/test and noisy pre-existing Clippy baseline without making an aggregate or warning-free claim.

validation.validation_method: Verification row audit, strict OpenSpec validation, manifest and constraints schema validation

global_rules: Use the change proposal, delta spec, and tasks as acceptance authority.
Do not treat client-supplied user or tenant identifiers as authorization input.
Report server-full, SurrealKV, and PostgreSQL 17 results separately and make no cross-profile claim.
Do not fix unrelated lint warnings while implementing isolation.
termination_conditions: Strict OpenSpec, schema validation, focused tests, and scoped diff checks exit successfully.
Independent artifact review finds no security or evidence blocker.
